title: Contract Tenure Credit Table — Rental Upgrade Difference Charges
content:
Tenure earns a credit on a Rental Property Service Contracts upgrade difference charge once the contract's original purchase date lies 730 days or more before the charge is billed.

| Original purchase date | Tenure credit |
|---|---|
| 1095 days or more before the charge is billed | 0.04 |
| 730 to 1094 days before | 0.02 |
| otherwise | 0 |

The original purchase date is the start date on the contract; the days are calendar days from it to the billing day.

**How the credit acts.** Concessions and credits on an upgrade difference charge are subtracted from one and a loading is added, all in one sum, and the charge is multiplied once by that sum before its single rounding to the cent.

| Days | Credit |
|---|---|
| 729 | 0 |
| 730 | 0.02 |
| 1095 | 0.04 |
